implementation_summary: Removed the bespoke interactive protocol from the backend now that A2UI replaces it. Deleted src/codemie/core/interactive.py (696 lines: ELEMENT_REGISTRY + 9 element models, InteractiveRequest/InteractiveResponse, InteractiveFeaturesConfig, validate_surface, build_surface_args_schema, render_interactive_elements_prompt, validate_response_values, enabled_element_types, default_element_catalog, size/regex limits) and src/codemie/service/conversation/interactive_intake.py (97 lines: validate_interactive_intake + materialize_interactive_*). Dropped the interactive_request/interactive_response fields from StreamedGenerationResult (chains/base.py), AssistantChatRequest (core/models.py), GeneratedMessage + ChatTurnData and their legacy branches in _build_chat_history_messages and to_chat_history (rest_api/models/conversation.py), and the interactive_request parameter of ConversationService.upsert_chat_history (service/conversation_service.py). Removed the legacy path from rest_api/handlers/assistant_handlers.py: _validate_interactive_response, its two call sites (Standard + A2A process_request), the interactive_request field of ChatHistoryData, the interactive_request stream-chunk interception in serve_data and its save_chat_history hand-off; the A2UI path (_validate_a2ui_action, _load_authorized_history, a2ui chunk accumulation) is untouched. Removed the interactive_features field from AssistantRequest and the AssistantBase JSONB column plus the AssistantRequest._sync_interactive_enabled normalizer (rest_api/models/assistant.py); the plain interactive_enabled boolean from T-BE4 is now the only switch. Removed the deprecated config parameter/field from RequestUserInputTool. New alembic revision d1c2b3a4e5f6 (down_revision f1a2b3c4d5e6, the verified head; ids a1b2c3d4e5f7/e7f8... were already taken) drops assistants.interactive_features, downgrade re-adds it as a nullable JSONB without backfill (data lives in interactive_enabled). Migration NOT applied to any database. Kept core/a2ui/legacy_converter.py and its tests (history migration needs the legacy shapes); its test helper _normalized no longer imports InteractiveRequest and fills the legacy element defaults from a local dict table instead. Deleted the legacy protocol test files and trimmed the legacy pieces out of test_request_user_input.py, test_interactive_turn_end.py and test_assistant_service_methods.py; the surviving interactive_enabled tests moved from tests/codemie/rest_api/models/test_assistant_interactive_features.py to test_assistant_interactive_enabled.py, plus a new test pinning that a legacy interactive_features payload is now ignored. No .ai-run guide mentioned the protocol (only an unrelated 'interactive shells' line), so guides were left alone.
passing_command: poetry run pytest tests/codemie -q && poetry run ruff check src tests && poetry run ruff format --check src tests
